title: Diagnostic Protocol for Evaluating the Clinical Performance of VENTANA FOLR1 (FOLR1-2.1) IUO Assay in Determining FOLR1 Status in Tumor Specimens from Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer Patients in AstraZeneca Phase 3 Study D8991C00001
summary:
Background
Ovarian cancer is a serious disease that can sometimes stop responding to standard treatments. When this happens, new treatment options are urgently needed. Researchers have developed a new trial drug designed to attack a specific target (a protein) that is often found on the surface of ovarian cancer cells. However, to make sure the right patients receive this new drug, doctors need a highly reliable laboratory test to check if a patient's tumor actually has this specific target protein.

Research question
Can this new investigational laboratory test accurately identify the presence and amount of the target protein on ovarian cancer cells, so that doctors can successfully select the most suitable patients for the associated drug treatment study?

Methodology
To perform this test, a small sample of the patient's tumor is needed. In most cases, a piece of tumor saved from a past surgery can be used, meaning no new medical procedures are required for the patient. If an old sample is not available, a new tissue sample will be collected.
This tissue is sent to a central laboratory, where it is sliced very thinly, placed on glass slides, and treated with a special testing liquid. A specially trained doctor then looks at the slides under a microscope to see if the target protein is present and in what amount. Based on what the doctor sees, patients are sorted into different groups to determine if they are eligible to join the main drug treatment trial. The laboratory test will be considered successful if the group of patients it identifies as suitable candidates ends up benefiting from the new drug treatment

interventions.name: • Intervention details: Patients with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian cancer (EOC) undergo an in vitro diagnostic evaluation using the investigational VENTANA FOLR1 (FOLR1-2.1) IUO Assay. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
To be eligible for staining with the VENTANA FOLR1 (FOLR1-2.1) IUO Assay in this diagnostic study, a specimen must meet all the following criteria: 
1. It must consist of archival or fresh biopsy EOC tumor tissue sample submitted to a Dx testing site for patient enrollment screening for Study D8991C00001;
2. It must consist of an FFPE tissue block or of at least 3 slides (5 preferred) containing serial sections cut from such a tissue block; 
3. It must appear to contain sufficient good-quality tissue consistent with EOC (including primary peritoneal cancer and primary fallopian tube cancer) specimen for VENTANA FOLR1 (FOLR1-2.1) IUO Assay staining and interpretation, as determined by a Dx site pathologist’s review of a tissue section stained with H&E; and
4. Cut slides must be stained within 4 months of sectioning
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion Criteria: A specimen will be excluded from the study if any of the following criteria are true:
1. It was fixed in alcohol-formalin-acetic acid (AFA), 95% alcohol, or any other alcohol-based fixative, zinc formalin, or PREFER™; or
2. It is a fine needle aspirate (FNA), any other cytological specimen (defined as a specimen lacking cellular context and tissue architecture); or
3. It consists of tissue containing bone that has been decalcified.
